implementationInterpretations: Minimum hand candidates include every living character including owner. Self selection is settled no-op; tie choices are current minima at actual payment, without exposing foreign hand faces. No primary FAQ found for this boundary.

Accepted Qingzhong draw arms its original actual Play phase debt; losing the source does not erase already-paid obligation. Owner death terminates future exchange; already-issued native child subtree drains exactly once.
The complete actual hands at exchange acceptance are moved atomically before movement observers; activation hand snapshots are not reused.

Weijing true zero-material ordinary Slash/Dodge share one quota per actual RoundStarted. Querying does not consume; actual accepted conversion consumes. Loss and reacquisition of same printed skill during same round do not reset paid allowance.
Native identity actor/provider/responder and action receipts govern cold reconstruction; no fake physical card or use-ID sidecar.

Official current Weijing text says use only. Official Longdan FAQ distinguishes Slash used during Play/Borrowed Sword from Slash played out against Duel/Barbarian, and Dodge used against Slash from Dodge played out against Arrow Barrage. Therefore Weijing provides only genuine native Slash uses and Slash-defense Dodge uses. This is a general-rule inference, not a dedicated Lu Zhi FAQ.

The same Weijing true-use allowance is offered by exact existing challenge, nearest-participant, selected-target assisted and nearest-legal Slash request producers. Separate immutable requester source/paused instruction and self-owned Weijing payer receipts preserve native UsedSlash result/cursor and exact child return. Faction card supply and already-free Mingce virtual Slash are excluded. Root wires four existing producers; no blanket zero-input permission.

Use-only request integration includes actual other-turn-ending Zhuhai UseOwnerSlashAgainstTurnOwner: original FixedTargetSlash target and distance exemption, actor/source owner equality, one payment, issued native child and original draft return. No play-out Duel/Barbarian/Arrow support. Added actual multi-target requested FireSlash fixture retains requester-damaged result after later extra target. These additions passed the final related focused scope.

A returned paid request ends with successful binding when the game has ended, before any unpaid tail. Focused fixture uses real Lord death inside paid native committed child with living source-valid requester. Lost-source Qingzhong ending uses exact issued debt/candidate/phase proof at cursor zero before its settling instruction arms pending state. Both passed the final related focused scope.
